tasks.title: Follow-offset live path: envelope slot-delta shift + explicit-action preserve + per-view gap
tasks.description: In chart_assets/lwc/chart.js, replace the followLive edge-pin (scrollToRealTime / {slot-span, slot} fallback) with an envelope slot-delta shift: snapshot newestBarSlot() before and after the applyOps envelope lands and, when followingBefore is true and delta N > 0, set {from: r.from + N, to: r.to + N} over the pre-update range. Add per chart-page-instance remembered gap state (default FRESH_FRAME_RIGHT_PADDING, refreshed on every observed following range, never shared cross-view); goToRealtime/chevron keeps span and lands newest at the remembered-gap offset, fitAndFollow frames all loaded bars then extends to by the remembered gap, and manual scroll/pinch stays the only zero-gap path.
acceptance_criteria: Given a following viewport with right-edge gap G logical slots where G is 0, 1, or 3, when an envelope landing exactly N new bar slots where N is 1 or 3 arrives while still following, then the visible logical range becomes {from + N, to + N} (span preserved) and the post-arrival gap equals G; G = 0 keeps the newest bar at the edge with no observable change.

Given any viewport state holding remembered gap G, when Fit/reset, chevron/goToRealtime click, or right-edge double-click/Fit fires, then follow re-engages with the post-action gap equal to G (span preserved; fit frames all loaded bars then extends to by G); and given any viewport, then a zero gap is observed only after a manual scroll/pinch to the edge.

Given a main view and a pop-out view each following with a different gap, when new bar slots arrive, then each view shifts its own range by the arrival width and preserves its own gap, and no gap value crosses between views or over the Python bridge.

Given a forming-bar tick envelope with zero new slots, or a hole-republish envelope appending N new slots, landing while following, then the visible range shifts by exactly the envelope newest-slot delta (zero for forming ticks so no per-tick jitter; exactly N once for a republish, never twice).

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a following viewport with right-edge gap G logical slots where G is 0, 1, or 3, when an envelope landing exactly N new bar slots where N is 1 or 3 arrives while still following, then the visible logical range becomes {from + N, to + N} (span preserved) and the post-arrival gap equals G; G = 0 keeps the newest bar at the edge with no observable change.
tests.description: Offscreen page-DOM viewport-slot matrix plus node --test core: seeded series, set a following range with gap G in {0,1,3}, inject N in {1,3} new slots through lwApplyOps, assert pre/post ranges and gap equality for all 6 cells on the main view. Red-first against the current scrollToRealTime snap path.
tests.expected_result: All 6 GxN cells shift by exactly N with post-arrival gap equal to G; the G=0 cells are unchanged from the current edge outcome.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given any viewport state holding remembered gap G, when Fit/reset, chevron/goToRealtime click, or right-edge double-click/Fit fires, then follow re-engages with the post-action gap equal to G (span preserved; fit frames all loaded bars then extends to by G); and given any viewport, then a zero gap is observed only after a manual scroll/pinch to the edge.
tests.description: Offscreen per-action preserve cases: from away and from following states with a known remembered gap, fire goToRealtime, fitAndFollow, and the double-click/Fit path, asserting post-action gap equals the remembered gap and follow re-engaged (isFollowing true); plus a manual scroll/pinch-to-edge case asserting the gap zeroes only there.
tests.expected_result: Every explicit action lands with gap equal to the remembered gap and follow re-engaged; only the manual scroll/pinch case shows a zero gap.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a main view and a pop-out view each following with a different gap, when new bar slots arrive, then each view shifts its own range by the arrival width and preserves its own gap, and no gap value crosses between views or over the Python bridge.
tests.description: Offscreen two-view case: two separate chart page instances following with different gaps (e.g. 1 and 3), inject the same new-slot arrival into each, asserting each preserves its own gap and that neither page instance exposes gap state to Python (no gap field on the bridge payload).
tests.expected_result: Each view shifts by the arrival width with its own gap intact; the two gaps never equalize and no gap crosses the bridge.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a forming-bar tick envelope with zero new slots, or a hole-republish envelope appending N new slots, landing while following, then the visible range shifts by exactly the envelope newest-slot delta (zero for forming ticks so no per-tick jitter; exactly N once for a republish, never twice).
tests.description: node --test envelope-delta cases plus one offscreen republish case: forming-tick-only envelopes assert zero range movement across repeated ticks; an opened-hole republish envelope appending N slots asserts exactly-N shift (AR-P21-1 double-shift guard).
tests.expected_result: Forming ticks move nothing; the republish envelope shifts exactly N with no second shift.

expected_artifacts: Envelope slot-delta shift + remembered-gap preserve logic in chart_assets/lwc/chart.js

tasks.title: Away-landing neutrality gate + session-open gap reset
tasks.description: Repro-first: drive the ES 5-min away repro (scrolled into the past with a wave in flight, land one chunk per leg) and confirm it fails on the current tree, then diagnose the moving call among the candidate sites (chunk render without same-symbol continuity, fresh-frame re-land on chunk, fitToWidth fallback on failed range re-apply). Route every landing through the preserve path (re-apply pre-replace range, no fresh frame, no range op) while away so the range stays bit-identical and follow stays disengaged; pin the session-open reset (carried gap never survives; fresh frame lands on its default) with carried-gap open cases, landing as tests-only if the reset verifies as already structural.
acceptance_criteria: Given an away viewport with the latest bar off-screen and a wave in flight, when a chunk lands via backfill continuation, via realtime update, and via prefetch arrival, then the visible range is bit-identical before and after each landing and follow stays disengaged; the repro fails on the pre-fix tree and the diagnosis names the moving call in the repro trace.

Given a scrolled-back viewport, when live bars arrive, then the visible range is unchanged and follow stays disengaged until pan-back-to-edge or an explicit action (AC-D51.2 regression guard stays green).
Given a carried non-zero follow-offset at session open, when the fresh frame lands, then the post-open gap equals the FRESH_FRAME_RIGHT_PADDING default with no stale gap carried across the open.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given an away viewport with the latest bar off-screen and a wave in flight, when a chunk lands via backfill continuation, via realtime update, and via prefetch arrival, then the visible range is bit-identical before and after each landing and follow stays disengaged; the repro fails on the pre-fix tree and the diagnosis names the moving call in the repro trace.
tests.description: Offscreen ES 5-min away repro per landing leg: scroll into the past intraday with a wave in flight, land one chunk per leg (backfill continuation, realtime update, prefetch arrival), asserting bit-identical visible range plus disengaged follow per leg; the repro is recorded failing pre-fix with the moving call named before the gate lands.
tests.expected_result: Repro fails pre-fix with the mover named; post-fix all three legs leave the away range bit-identical and follow disengaged.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a scrolled-back viewport, when live bars arrive, then the visible range is unchanged and follow stays disengaged until pan-back-to-edge or an explicit action (AC-D51.2 regression guard stays green).
tests.description: Offscreen away-arrival identity suites: scrolled-back viewports receiving live-bar arrivals assert unchanged ranges and disengaged follow; the existing AC-D51.2 suites are re-run unchanged as the regression guard.
tests.expected_result: Away arrivals move nothing and follow stays disengaged; all AC-D51.2 suites stay green.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a carried non-zero follow-offset at session open, when the fresh frame lands, then the post-open gap equals the FRESH_FRAME_RIGHT_PADDING default with no stale gap carried across the open.
tests.description: Offscreen carried-gap session-open cases: seed a non-zero remembered gap, drive a session open / fresh-frame land, assert the post-open gap equals the fresh-frame default; if the reset verifies as already structural, these land as tests-only with no production edit claimed.
tests.expected_result: Post-open gap equals FRESH_FRAME_RIGHT_PADDING regardless of the carried gap.

expected_artifacts: Away-landing gate in chart_assets/lwc/chart.js and/or ui/lwc_view.py (landings deliver bars only, never navigation)
tests/test_d60_away_landing.py (per-leg away repro, away-arrival identity, session-open reset)
outputs: Away-neutral landings on all three legs
